Step 1: Start date 1455-12-25.  
Step 2: 11 weeks + 6 days = 11×7 + 6 = 83 days.  
Step 3: 1455-12-25 + 83 days:  
Dec 25 → Dec 31 is 6 days (remain 77 days).  
Jan 1456 is leap year (divisible by 4) → 31 days (remain 46 days).  
Feb 1456 has 29 days (remain 17 days).  
Mar 1 + 17 days = Mar 18, 1456.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1456-03-18
